replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is my favorite subject alongside computer science. I enjoy solving problems and finding patterns, though sometimes it can feel overwhelming when things get too abstract. My parents didn't have much formal education, so I had to work hard to understand concepts on my own.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes I do. When the math gets complex or I don't understand a concept quickly, I feel stressed. But I try to stay calm and break things down step by step. My high conscientiousness helps me keep pushing through difficult problems.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools recently. They helped explain concepts clearly and gave me practice problems. It made learning easier and faster, especially for topics I found challenging before. I appreciated how patient and clear the explanations were.

Take the derivative of f(x) with respect to x. Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values give you the stationary points. Substitute them back into the original function to get the corresponding y-coordinates.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can provide personalized tutoring, explain concepts in different ways, generate practice problems, and give instant feedback. parsed.reasoning_summary: Answers reflect a conscientious, high-extraversion man with low openness who enjoys math but sometimes feels anxious about complexity. His self-employed status and lower secondary education background show practical problem-solving skills. He values AI tools for learning support and sees LLMs as helpful educational resources that reduce anxiety through personalized guidance.
